messages.text: Your cookware set is marked as shipped, not delivered, so it isn’t eligible for a refund yet through this process (refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders). The shop must also receive it back before issuing a refund (refund-policy/v1/return).
What can I do to return it and get a refund once it arrives?

messages.text:
I don’t have a return address or label instructions available here, so I can’t give you the shipping steps.

Once it arrives:
1. Arrange the return with the shop’s support team.
2. After the shop records the cookware set as received back, ask here for a refund proposal (refund-policy/v1/return).
3. Review the proposed amount and confirm using the button on the proposal card. A staff member must then approve it before payment (refund-policy/v1/approval).
